## App-wide facts (not specific to one logical module)

- Config/runtime wiring: `src/main/webapp/WEB-INF/web.xml` (filters, listeners, servlets), `src/main/resources/struts.xml`, `META-INF/persistence.xml` (unit `RollerPU`, EclipseLink) [verified: web.xml:38-331; persistence.xml:31-59]
- Schema scripts: `app/src/main/resources/sql/` (Velocity `createdb.vm`, `*-to-*-migration.vm`, per-DB dirs); protected in config.yaml [verified: .ai-sdlc/config.yaml `protect:`]
- Tests: JUnit Jupiter + Mockito + Instancio; Derby for DB tests; Jing for XML [verified: app/pom.xml:539-584]. Surefire sets `-Djavax.xml.accessExternalSchema=all` [verified: app/pom.xml:742]
- Hibernate is intentionally excluded (LGPL); only EclipseLink is active [verified: app/pom.xml comment ~145-157]
- Config files: `roller.properties` (defaults) and `roller-custom.properties` (override) [verified: resources/org/apache/roller/weblogger/config/roller.properties]
- Filter order in web.xml matters (bootstrap/init before request mapping) [inferred]
